name: Ciara McKinley
source: A sixth-year belonging to the House Talamhdan. Ciara seems to be more interested in normie stuff that the school's magic curriculum. Some say that she is a little bit strange, but Ciara nonetheless manages to capture the hearts of anyone she approaches.
